svg.title: Terra Nova — Tectonic Creed. Draft 3 / Terra Nova classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Fault Line forks into Rending Strata then Continental Rift, or Burden of Stone then Pressure of Ages. Bedrock Stance forks into Rampart Discipline then Unmoved Mountain, or Weight Behind the Blow then Landslide Momentum. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Terra Nova jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Earth Wall (40 AP self cast) carries the only two self buffs: its Decrease Damage Taken row lists all four stat types and no element, so it blunts nearly every non-pierce hit, while its Increase Damage Given row is Earth-only and amplifies Earth damage alone, so fortification outranks amplification in coverage breadth, not in flats. Earthen Fortitude's 30% Decrease Damage Given rides on the single-target hit and is the kit's only supported enemy debuff (Terra Spire's recoil and wound are enemy debuffs outside potency). The three single-row percentage tags are deliberately symmetric at the +10 guardrail, so the secondary/tertiary ordering is presentational, and whether the Earth-only IDG route should stop at +8 instead is the user decision named in risks; no Afterburn, heal, lifesteal or reflect route is invented."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Fault Line","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":1,"display_role":"DAMAGE"},{"tag":"decreasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"The ground splits where you choose, and your enemy stands on the wrong side.","coverage_note":"Fortitude and Terra Spire Earth damage 38\u219239 (2 rows, 60 AP, CD 7); Fortitude's Decrease Damage Given 30\u219232% for 2 rounds on one enemy.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Terra Nova","scope":"Terra Nova jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Earthen Fortitude","Terra Spire"],"effect_rows":3}},{"id":"02","name":"Rending Strata","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":2,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"Layer by layer, the earth is torn open.","coverage_note":"Both Earth damage rows (Earthen Fortitude single target, Terra Spire AOE spiral): 39\u219241 power with Fault Line. Momentum"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: Fault Line raises both Earth damage rows and Fortitude's suppression, forking into Rending Strata \u2192 Continental Rift (damage) and Burden of Stone \u2192 Pressure of Ages (suppression). Bedrock Stance raises both Earth Wall rows, forking into Rampart Discipline \u2192 Unmoved Mountain (fortify) and Weight Behind the Blow \u2192 Landslide Momentum (amplify). 2 F / 4 H / 4 A; every capstone 3 BP deep; any two capstones 5\u20136 BP. Ten nodes because the four tags are four distinct roles.","Reference reuse: topology and Hidden/Advanced flats copy Taiyo Kami nearly verbatim (+2/+3 Damage; 2+3+5 = +10 on DDG 30\u219240%, DDT 35\u219245%, IDG 35\u219245%); the kit splits the same way (attacks, self-cast). Departures: Fault Line adds +1 Damage on 2 damage rows (Taiyo: 3), route +6 (38\u219244); DDG on the attack root, IDG on the Wall root; no Afterburn/IDT; capstone secondaries +1 Damage/+2 IDG/+2 DDT, below each sibling Hidden Art. Examples row-weight 18 (Taiyo: examples 20\u201329, builds 16\u201331, nine rows).","Matching (tags.ts getEfficiencyRatio, 3477\u20133510): the DDT and DDG rows list four stat types and no element, so their tag list includes None and they alter every non-pierce hit whose stat resolves to one of the four or that is element-less (basic attacks and weapons included). Earth Wall's IDG row has no stat types and elements ['Earth'] only, so its tag list is exactly ['Earth']: it amplifies Earth-element damage alone, never basic attacks or non-elemental jutsu.","Passives: the bloodline's Earth Increase Damage Given passive (15% + 0.15/level, fromType bloodline) multiplies every enhanced Earth damage row, so +6 power is worth more than +6 after it. The +10% Lightning Increase Damage Taken passive is the kit's weakness; Earth Wall's DDT row (element-less, four stat types) subtracts its share from Lightning hits on the two rounds after its cast, softening that weakness for 2 of every 7 rounds. Both passives are suppressed in ranked modes (\u00a75).","Delivery and uptime: all three jutsu have cooldown 7. Earth Wall's (40 AP, SELF target) buffs are live on the two rounds after its cast round (\u00a73b), never in it: 2-in-7 uptime for both self routes. Earthen Fortitude (60 AP, range 4, single target) lands its hit in the cast round and its suppression on the two rounds after. Terra Spire (60 AP) hits enemies on a radius-4 spiral around the caster with Earth damage and unsupported recoil; its wound also reaches allies. Potency changes values only.","Fourth purchases: Burst \u2192 Bedrock Stance (Wall 37%/37%) or Burden of Stone (suppression 35%; attack-root only, no Earth Wall); Suppression \u2192 Bedrock Stance or Rending Strata (attacks 42); Fortified \u2192 Fault Line (attacks 39, suppression 32%) or Weight Behind the Blow (amplify 42%); Amplify \u2192 Fault Line or Rampart Discipline (DDT 42%). Strongest unadvertised build by row weight: 01,02,04,05 (DDG +10, Damage +4) ties the examples at 18. Lowest-value nodes: the three +3 single-row Hidden Arts."],"risks":["Classification: Earth is a basic element carried by 23 other census bloodlines and, unverified, by ordinary jutsu, so the label is the bloodline-keyed extension 'Terra Nova' (resolver change and extension). Under the current resolver an Earth modifier reaches the 3 Earth rows directly and the 2 element-less rows only via None, which also reaches every non-elemental row the player casts.","Earth-only amplify (open user decision): Earth Wall's IDG row matches Earth damage alone (element list lacks None), so Landslide Momentum's 45% skips basic attacks and non-Earth jutsu. The draft keeps +5 (route +10, symmetric with DDT/DDG) because the scope is narrow; the alternative is +3 (route 2+3+3 = +8), leaving DDT as the only +10 self route and making the declared ordering real.","Broad fortification: Unmoved Mountain puts Earth Wall's DDT at 45% for 2 rounds, matching every non-pierce hit whose stat is one of the four or that is element-less, Lightning included. Same-tag effects all apply (process.ts 1109\u20131117), so 45% adds to any other DDT on the caster (plus a 30% source: 75% of staged base). Cooldown 7 exceeds the 2 rounds, so own casts never overlap.","Suppression leakage: Pressure of Ages puts Earthen Fortitude's Decrease Damage Given at 40% for 2 rounds on one target; the debuff reduces that enemy's damage to the caster's allies as well (any stat-based or element-less hit, pierce excluded), so the route is worth more in team battles than one row suggests. It is a single-target 60 AP cast on cooldown 7; the kit has no area suppression.","Single-cast concentration: both Earth Wall routes raise rows of one 40 AP D-rank SELF-target cast (only the caster receives them), and both attack-root routes share Earthen Fortitude; Earth Wall's per-AP value rises more than the damage route's. All four capstones depend on one jutsu each, so a prevented or sealed cast removes the route's value for that cooldown cycle.","Terra Spire's recoil and wound rows are unsupported. The spiral is centred on the caster (radius 4, own tile removed; \u00a73b); the wound row lacks friendlyFire (= ALL), so allies within it receive the wound and the caster never does (OTHER_USER area rows reach only living non-caster users: actions.ts 1029\u20131060, 1226\u20131248). No node touches it, but the Damage route invites casting Spire near allies.","Highest-stat resolution (\u00a74b, G16): both damage rows list statTypes 'Highest', resolved from the caster's highestOffence, a required BattleUserState field (types.ts 156), so enemy DDT buffs and DDG debuffs with four-stat filters match and blunt the boosted hits. Their Earth element is what matches Earth Wall's amplify; only an elemental hit with no stat type escapes the four-stat DDT/DDG rows.","Damage is formula-calculated with sqrt stat scaling, then the Earth passive multiplies it, while Earth Wall's amplify (live from an earlier cast) adds 35\u201345% of the staged base, so +6 raw power is not linear +6 damage. g.text: Draft 3 / Terra Nova classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Terra Nova jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Pressure of Ages path + Bedrock Stance
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
